name: Kinder Morgan Rancho Pipeline (Phases I and II)
monitor_reason: length: both phases are EIA 'Conversion' projects (existing 24-inch oil line converted to gas), so no new pipe is added. Both are already completed (2004 and 2005), so there is no open step to track either.
researcher_notes: No row named Rancho exists in the GEM gas snapshot, so this is not a match to an existing row. The EIA pipeline projects release of August 2026, sheet Historical Projects, lists Excel row 330 (KM Rancho Pipeline Phase I, Kinder Morgan Energy Partners, Conversion, Completed, in service July 2004, Texas, 177 mi, 24 inch, intrastate, state regulated) and Excel row 371 (Phase II, completed October 2005, 254 mi, 24 inch). The release is a single origin and no second source was sought, since a conversion adds no new pipe and fails the 25 km length rule. Worth a later look as a possible missing operating row of about 431 mi in West Texas (Permian), which would need a Texas Railroad Commission or operator source and a decision on whether converted lines count as gas pipelines. Not staged as a new row.
